name: Durabook R8-EX
summary: The Durabook R8-EX is the hazardous-area version of a Durabook rugged 8-inch tablet, certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX. It is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) design running Windows 11 Pro.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic IIC T4 Gc / II 3D Ex ic IIIB T135°C Dc
atex.status: ATEX certificate of conformity number quoted in the user manual (ATEX file R8 01, R2, 2025-07-31); status not independently checked; no IECEx; UKEX not found

safety.conditions: Must be used with the ATEX case supplied by Twinhead, packed as the manual describes. Must not be connected to any external device. Battery may only be charged in a safe area with the supplied adapter (FSP065-RBBN3, 19 V, 3.42 A, 65 W). Do not replace or charge the battery in explosive environments. Do not use the device without the ATEX case in explosive environments. Use only Japone Technology R8-H (7200 mAh) or R8-M (3600 mAh) batteries.
safety.peripherals: Per the manual: the tablet shall not be connected to any external device. All I/O ports are covered by explosion-proof brackets that must be fitted (with screws) before entering the ATEX area. The anti-static leather case is mandatory.
safety.certifiedAccessories: Supplied with the Ex tablet and part of the certification: ATEX anti-static leather case, left bracket and screws (explosion-proof brackets), stylus and tether, stylus holder. AC adapter and power cord are for the safe area only. Docking connector, keyboard, dock and scanner: none named as Ex-certified.

os.name: Windows
os.updates: Windows 11: supported while kept on a current version (Microsoft Modern Lifecycle)

specs.chip: Intel Core i7-1250U vPro / i5-1230U vPro (12th gen) or Pentium Gold 8500
specs.hotSwap: Optional swappable battery, 5 minute swap (system stays on within 300 s in standby)
specs.ports: Thunderbolt 4, USB 3.2 Gen2 Type-C, audio combo, microSDXC, 20-pin pogo docking, nano-SIM, DC-in; optional USB-A, 1D/2D barcode; all behind explosion-proof brackets in the Ex version
specs.docking: 20-pin pogo docking connector (office/vehicle docks for standard R8; not for the Ex area)
specs.gnss: Optional dedicated GPS or GPS with 4G LTE (mutually exclusive)
specs.storage: 128 GB NVMe (options 256 GB, 512 GB, 1000 GB), microSDXC
specs.ruggedness: MIL-STD-810H; 6 ft (1.8 m), 26 faces (tablet; effect of case not stated)

capabilities.label: Remote expert / video calls
capabilities.value: Via app (2 MP front, optional 11 MP rear)

limitations: Zone 2 only, so not for Zone 1 areas
T4 temperature class: fine for most gases, but not those that ignite below 135 °C
Dust group IIIB: combustible flyings and non-conductive dust only, not conductive dust
